connector.name: N3fjp MCP
connector.registryDescription: Log amateur-radio QSOs to N3FJP logging software over its TCP API.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package n3fjp-mcp. No credential is declared, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the sbrunner-atx account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: No credential is declared in the registry record. A hosted endpoint may still apply its own rate limits or sign in step.

env.name: N3FJP_PORT
env.description: N3FJP API port (Settings → Application Program Interface). Default 1100. Not the multi-PC networking port.

env.name: N3FJP_TIMEOUT
env.description: Seconds to wait for an N3FJP response.

env.name: N3FJP_ALLOW_DB_WIPE
env.description: DANGER. When off (default), raw SQL that could delete/overwrite the entire log (DROP/TRUNCATE, unscoped DELETE/UPDATE) is refused. Only enable with a backup and full understanding of the risk.
